nodes.hypothesis: Hypothyroidism due to complete thyroidectomy is causing thyroid hormone deficiency leading to cardiovascular complications.
nodes.mechanism: Complete thyroidectomy removes the thyroid gland, which produces thyroid hormones. Without these hormones, the patient may develop hypothyroidism, leading to cardiovascular issues such as bradycardia, hypotension, and heart failure. Elevated TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone) levels indicate the pituitary gland is stimulating the thyroid to produce more hormones, which is a compensatory mechanism in response to hypothyroidism.
